Termux terminal-emulator and TerminalRenderer
Pinned source: https://github.com/termux/termux-app
Revision: 5b657c6adf4304e5198951ce815fe0205dcac29c (v0.118.3)

These terminal libraries descend from Terminal Emulator for Android by Jack Palevich
and contributors, with Termux changes by Fredrik Fornwall and contributors. They are
Apache License 2.0 exceptions to the upstream app's GPLv3 license, as stated in the
included UPSTREAM-LICENSE.txt. LICENSE-APACHE-2.0.txt contains the license text.
All existing source notices are retained. Per-file upstream SHA-256 and paths are
recorded in upstream.lock.json.

Only VT parser, buffer, colors, Unicode width, key mapping and Canvas renderer are
vendored. We do not use upstream TerminalSession, JNI, or TerminalView. In particular,
we do not use its private FileDescriptor reflection. Our app owns the PTY lifecycle
and public Android input/view integration.

Local adaptations (not upstream):
- TerminalSessionClient is narrowed to emulator callbacks/logging with no-op defaults,
  removing references to the excluded upstream TerminalSession.
- Logger has no global Android Log fallback, so parser tests run on a plain JVM.
- TerminalEmulator uses java.util.Base64 (public on Android API 26 and JVM) in place
  of android.util.Base64. Its VT state machine is otherwise unchanged.
